_note: Most-permissive safety config per provider (Spec B AC-2.2). Values are the documented API maximum-permissiveness; a provider that ignores a param is noted. fal is per-model (its params vary by model — the sweep reads the model schema via permissive_params()).

fal._note: resolved per model from its param schema (permissive_params); not all fal models expose all three.

novita._note: Novita applies its own moderation server-side on some models regardless; the flag is best-effort.

agnes._note: AGNES exposes no documented safety-override param; sent with defaults. A refusal here is provider policy, recorded as such.
